question: Hauler ghost-tank look. Built so far: Rivet's own cutout parts scaled 2.6x (matches the 0.9 m rivet_ghost body). A plain scale-up keeps his long arms, which reach past the cops. Which direction for the tank silhouette (all keep teal = souls)?

options.label: Scaled Rivet + teal ghost tint (as built, plus tint)
options.tradeoff: cheapest, clearly 'Rivet grown'; inherits the long-arm read you disliked

options.label: Bulked: wider torso, short thick arms (fore/upper lengths ~0.6x), teal tint, same parts
options.tradeoff: a squat press-bot tank silhouette from existing parts and data only; frames next iteration

options.label: New tank art (armour plates, press head) via image_gen, on the same rig
options.tradeoff: best read and canon (heavy press bot); costs an art pass and an ask before generating
